policy: Records omitted from this file are deliberate keeps from the source-audited translation.

changes.T22/g0/r0: Jailer: Ah, Baron. You've come to see your wife? She's in grave danger… Baron: My wife, a witch? What proof do they have?! Where is the bishop?! He's so obsessed with hunting witches that he's neglecting the Church itself. Isn't that true?! Jailer: Yes. Some even say the bishop serves Satan. Baron: If only we had proof, we could drive him out…
changes.T22/g0/r4: Jailer: If only we had proof… Just thinking aloud.
changes.T22/g0/r5: Woman: I'm not a witch! Please let me out! My child is waiting at home. Please, Brother…
changes.T22/g0/r8: Jailer: No. Without the bishop's permission, I cannot let her out.
changes.T22/g0/r10: "PACT — O Devil, lord of darkness, I kneel before you. You are my god of justice. I devote myself to vice, slander, and every evil. —The Bishop"
changes.T22/g0/r11: Baron: Th-this is…! Jailer: It's in his own hand! Baron: I knew it… Jailer: We have to save her! Baron: Right!
changes.T22/g0/r12: Woman: Are they going to burn us? Woman: Oh, God…
changes.T22/g0/r13: Baron: Isabelle… I swear I'll save you. Isabelle: I love you. Baron: And I love you.
changes.T22/g0/r14: Jailer: You must remain here. Those are the bishop's orders.
changes.T22/g0/r15: Bishop: Ho ho ho… First, she burns. You will wait here until then. Ho ho ho…
changes.T22/g0/r18: His face is contorted with pain.
changes.T22/g0/r30: A magic circle is drawn on the floor, with a large box at its center.
changes.T22/g0/r31: It's covered in eerie ornaments. I've seen this before…
changes.T22/g1/r6: Bishop: Once a crowd has gathered, burn her. Let her be an example to the rest. Ho ho ho…
changes.T22/g1/r7: Bishop: Jeanne d'Arc, granddaughter of Lugot—depraved, baptized by the Devil. The Church sentences her to death.
changes.T22/g1/r8: Baron: Stop! Stop this at once! That girl is no witch! The bishop is the one who serves Satan!
changes.T22/g1/r9: Bishop: N-nonsense… Baron: Silence! Your pact with the Devil is proof enough!
changes.T22/g1/r10: The crowd falls silent. Then… Man: How dare you…! Man: Get the girl down! Man: Seize the bishop! He's the one who belongs on the pyre!
changes.T22/g1/r11: Bishop: W-wait! Listen to me! Man: Shut up! Bishop: Aaaah!!
changes.T22/g1/r14: They're going to torture her little by little…?
changes.T22/g1/r15: His eyes are red and swollen from crying.
changes.T22/g1/r17: Man: Damn… I can't watch this. Man: God help her!
changes.T22/g1/r18: Bishop: L-let go of me, you fools! You'll pay for this!
changes.T22/g1/r19: Lugot: Hold on, Jeanne! Jeanne: Ugh…
changes.T22/g1/r20: Lugot: Thank God… sob… Jeanne: From that cross, I heard God's message. Lugot: A revelation?! Jeanne: Put on white armor and fight for your homeland. Wherever you lead the charge, a new road will open… Lugot: Jeanne…
changes.T22/g1/r21: Jeanne d'Arc… hailed as a child of God, the fair savior of France…
